sections.title: Zid store design
sections.text: We set up your catalog, pages and categories inside Zid and connect orders, shipping and invoicing, so your store runs day to day without repetitive manual work.

sections.title: Four areas that shape how well your store runs every day
sections.text: A store is more than a storefront. We organize the catalog, orders, customers and integrations so there's less manual work and fewer errors.

items.heading: Catalog

items.heading: Orders

items.heading: Customers

items.question: When is Zid the right choice?
items.answer: When local operations are a priority: orders, shipping, payment and invoicing in one dashboard, with local support.

items.question: What's the difference between building on Zid and on Salla?
items.answer: Both are local platforms, but they differ in theme structure, catalog management and integrations, so the setup plan is different for each.

items.question: Do you connect inventory and invoicing systems?
items.answer: We connect the integrations the platform offers, and we identify alternatives when the integration you need isn't available.

items.question: Can you optimize my Zid store's pages for search?
items.answer: Yes, within the platform's capabilities: the category structure, descriptions, titles and meta tags.

items.question: Do you upload the products?
items.answer: Product upload and product data organization is a separate service that can be added to your project.

items.question: Can you migrate my store from another platform?
items.answer: Yes. We move your products and categories and put a redirect plan in place for your old URLs.
